description: Defines the torch::jit::Object class and related components for JIT compilation, including attribute access, method invocation, and property management.

classes.name: Object
classes.description: Represents a JIT object with attribute and method management capabilities.

classes.name: ObjectAttributeError
classes.description: Exception thrown when attribute access fails.

methods.name: setattr
methods.description: Sets an attribute value, checking for constants and attribute existence.

methods.name: attr
methods.description: Retrieves an attribute value by name, throws if not found.

methods.name: attr
methods.description: Retrieves an attribute value or returns a default if not found.

methods.name: hasattr
methods.description: Checks if an attribute or constant exists.

methods.name: get_method
methods.description: Retrieves a method by name, throws if not found.

methods.name: get_methods
methods.description: Returns all methods of the object.

methods.name: get_property
methods.description: Retrieves a property by name, throws if not found.

methods.name: get_properties
methods.description: Returns all properties of the object.

methods.name: find_method
methods.description: Finds a method by basename, returns optional.

methods.name: run_method
methods.description: Runs a method with provided arguments.

methods.name: define
methods.description: Defines new methods or properties from source code.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Creates a shallow copy of the object.

methods.name: deepcopy
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the object including attributes.
